title: Rig Module
text: According to the program forms found inside one, the deep rigs were built in modules so a crew could ride the hole down in stages. No such design appears in any published record. The module is riveted hull plate, eight meters long, buried whole with no shaft above it. Its stencils match the Zarya log books: same forms, same units, the same unit number scratched out. Every outer hatch was welded shut from the inside, neatly, by someone who knew how. The bunks are made. Five cups hang in the galley rack, and a sixth hook is empty. The tape cases are sealed with program wax and addressed to a depth, not a place.
teaser: A drill module welded shut from the inside.
